title: Tomato found out he's a fruit and lost it 😭🍅
hook: When someone calls Tomato a vegetable:
description: One curiosity-driven sentence for the YouTube description.

lines.text: A VEGETABLE?! Say that to my seeds!
I grow from a flower. I have seeds. Fruit. Period.
lines.fact: Botanically, tomatoes are fruits: they grow from a flower and carry seeds.

lines.text: Bro, you're literally going in a salad tonight.
